translations.web: All those who were counted of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted, by their families and by their fathers’ houses,
translations.bsb: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel numbered by their clans and families all the Levites
translations.kjv: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
